name: Touryou Made Matenai!
source:
Hikaru promises to beat his rival Akira in a Go game every day for a certain time. But there are also events in the everyday life outside the battlefield.

[From [url=https://vndbreview.blogspot.com/2019/10/vn-of-month-august-2005-saihate-no-ima.html]vndbreview[/url]]
translation:
Hikaru承诺每天在一定时间内在围棋比赛中击败他的对手Akira。但战场之外的日常生活中也有一些事件。

[来自[url=https://vndbreview.blogspot.com/2019/10/vn-of-month-august-2005-saihate-no-ima.html]vndbreview[/url]]
